notes.title: Realpolitiks 3 | Beta Version of New Patch is Here!
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow leaders!

We believe we have been able to identify the cause and fix the pesky bug causing save games to become corrupted. This will unfortunately not recover the non-functioning saves, and as with any update to Realpolitiks 3, we cannot guarantee it will be compatible with older saves at all.

Therefore, we have decided to put the updated version into a Beta version right now, so that those who want to try it out, can, and those who want to continue their current saved games, can do so without disturbance. 

To access the updated version, head to your Steam Library, right-click Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond, left-click Properties, left-click Betas and from the drop-down menu select the option "beta - Upcoming Patch". Your game will then update and you can start playing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110866/e2435eb81217e9f5ee0f4ebd6dccb9c3442ece0c.png

Please let us know if you encounter the save corrupting bug in the Beta version, or if it's smooth sailing for you. The best way to do that is by joining the "Realpolitiks HQ" Discord server, but of course, feel free to just comment on this announcement, or come to the Steam Discussions, we read your posts everywhere!

And if you come across any bug or technical issue, when reporting it be sure to describe the problem in detail, and include your save file and log file, which you can find here: C:\Users\%username%\AppData\LocalLow\Jujubee\RP3
(Simply archive all the contents of the folder and upload it to gdrive, wetransfer or any other file sharing service, and send us the link).

Happy Strategizing!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/

notes.title: Realpolitiks 3 | Critical Bugfixing Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow leaders!

We have just released a critical update, which fixes many of the issues you have been reporting since the game left Early Access. First and foremost, we are happy to report that not only will new saves not become corrupted anymore, but we have managed to implement fixes that ensure the ones affected by the bug are now playable again. If you find that this is not the case for you, please, contact us and send us the save files in question and we will try to recover them for you.

Besides bug fixes, we also improved game balance - most notably in the Stability system. Improving Stability will now be easier and faster, and Stability penalties caused by difference between the political affiliation of your country and your actions (for example if your society is largely conservative, but you push through liberal-leaning actions, or if you act as an autocrat in a heavily democratic society, etc.).

Full list of changes can be found below, but rest assured that we will continue to closely monitor your feedback and keep fixing bugs and generally improving the game. Please, if you encounter any issues or think of any suggestions for Realpolitiks 3, contact us on the Realpolitiks Discord server or here on Steam in the Discussions. We want to keep making your ruling experience as smooth and as enjoyable as possible.

Happy Strategizing!

Full Change Log:

 Fixed the corrupted saves issue - new ones should not break and old affected saves should be playable now - if not, please contact us
 Fixed a bug causing incorrect peace negotiations screen
 Fixed a bug which prevented players from capturing land from secondary enemies
 Fixed a bug causing projects and technologies to progress twice as fast as they should
 Fixed a bug causing countries the player has no pacts with to ask them to join a war
 Fixed a bug causing broken warscore
 Stability will now rise by 2 points every year
 Lowered the cooldown of the Invest in Stability action
 Increased the cooldown for Stabilization penalties
 Increased the amount of resources in provinces
 Increased income from Taxes
 Increased Destiny Points income
 Updated effects and costs of certain projects
 Updated conditions for war deceleration actions
 Added several missing localization texts
 Fixed the strategic point on Sao Tomo Island
 Various UI fixes

notes.title: Realpolitiks 3 | Development Continues - A Patch Is on Its Way
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow leaders!

As we've promised when we've released the latest hotfix, we are finalizing a patch that aims to fix many of the issues you've reported to us. We are sorry that serious bugs managed to sneak through our testing and spoiled the experience of so many of you at our full release - but we want to reassure you that we are working hard on another update and even with the Early Access period behind us, we will keep working to ensure that any aspiring world leader will be able to enjoy Realpolitiks 3 and have fun with the game.

The most important issues we are working on are the "corrupt saves" bug and the error preventing some players from negotiating with certain nations; but we are also looking into improving the balancing of the stability system to make drops in stability caused by the dissonance between your actions and your country's political affiliation more predictable and easily understandable, as well as many other smaller bugfixes and improvements (we will be looking at further improving the optimization too). Those changes might come in further, separate patches, as we are trying to release the critical-bug-fixing update as soon as possible.

We would also like to sincerely thank each and every one of our players who take the time to report the bugs and thus help us fix them. We understand how frustrating it is when a game bugs out; if you are one of those diehard fans who send us a detailed description of what happened to them, what they were doing ingame at the time, what their PC specs are (this is especially important when reporting problems with performance) and any other details they can remember, along with their logs and save files, please know that you are deeply appreciated and we are doing all we can to fix the problems you find. Thank you!

If you would also like to help us by reporting a bug you've found, the perfect place to do so is the Realpolitiks HQ Discord server. If you prefer Steam instead, you can use the discussion forum here as well. And if you are unsure how to deliver the logs and saves we mentioned, it's really easy - just upload all contents of the following folder to any file-sharing service such as gdrive or dropbox and send us the link: 
C:\Users\username\AppData\LocalLow\Jujubee\RP3

Thank you for staying with us. We will have news about our progress on the upcoming patch soon!

notes.title: Realpolitiks 3 | Hotfix is Live & More Fixes on the Way!
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow leaders!

Even though Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond is now out of Early Access and fully released, we are still collecting feedback and bug reports from you and working on various fixes to the game. For now, we have put together a small patch, fixing several UI issues and problems related to certain language localizations.

However, we are also hard at work on the much bigger issues, notably the save-corrupting bug some of you have experienced; that in particular is our main priority, and it is actually tied in to several different problems, such as the bug preventing some players from negotiating peace treaties after wars with certain smaller nations. We hope to start testing an update with these fixes next week and get it released quickly.

We will continue to closely monitor your feedback, whether it's on the Realpolitiks Discord server or here on Steam, so please, keep reporting any bugs you find, and posting any suggestions that come to your mind - we'd like to keep supporting the game for as long as needed, fixing any issues that prevent you from enjoying ruling your country, and even rebalancing the game if necessary, based on what we learn from you.

Attaching logs and save files would be helpful as well – please send us everything you find in this folder:

C:\Users\%username%\AppData\LocalLow\Jujubee\RP3

Happy Strategizing!

notes.title: Realpolitiks 3 | The Changing World Update is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow leaders!

We bring excellent news - we have just released the second of our planned Early Access Content Updates, dubbed "The Changing World.” As the name implies, it puts into your hands many tools and features allowing you to leave a mark on the Earth and other planets of our Solar system. For example, you will be able to liberate states, change the names of provinces and countries, move your capital and more!

You will also be able to tackle the challenges posed by the ever-changing world by using new tools, such as enacting Martial Law for an immediate boost to your countries stability and lowered dissent among population, and the ability to bypass the parliament when setting up projects and actions, but your relations with other nations will suffer and the dissatisfaction of your population will grow for as long as martial law is in effect. You will also be able to use your influence to help (or harm) the new Non-Governmental Organizations (NGO's), which can provide useful bonuses, but also penalties, if their views are not aligned with your doctrines.

As with most updates, we highly recommend starting a new campaign to enjoy the full range of new features, fixes and improvements, the list of which is available below. We can't wait to see what you think about the update, and how you will wield the new tools it places at your disposal!

Full Change Log
New features

 Possibility to change the names of provinces, countries, etc. 
 Different ways to win: Technological Victory, Cultural Victory, Economic Victory, Diplomatic Victory, Military Victory
 Moving the capital

 New events and tasks
 New sounds
 New faces for the countries of the Arab civilization

 Fixed bugs with AI block creation
 Fixed bugs with nukes
 Fixed bugs with wars

 Planes can now be removed
 Fixed bug with unrealistically large migrations
 Fixed HDI projection problems
 Fixed detection of province neighbors and army pathfinding

Thank you for joining us on our Early Access journey, and helping us to improve the gameplay experience - if you encounter any issues or bugs, or just want to share your thoughts or suggestions, contact us either through the Realpolitiks HQ Discord, here on Steam or by email to contact@jujubee.pl.

notes.title: Realpolitiks 3 | Fire and Brimstone Update Out Now!
notes.notes:
Greetings, fellow leaders!

With the Holiday season almost upon us, we would like to give all the Realpolitiks fans an early Christmas present - the first large Content Update for Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond, which is currently in Early Access. We call it the "Fire and Brimstone" Update, since what better way to celebrate the Holidays than by scorching the planet with nuclear fire?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110866/f4fb64cf784926fa797fe71e3f4b0a26451688ec.gif

But of course, our game is all about the freedom to choose how you want to rule - if you want to treat the world as a garden rather than a battlefield, the update brings new options for enacting environmental policies. Perhaps you will be able to save the Earth, rather than destroy it - the choice is yours!

New Features

 Nuclear Weapons Mechanics: Manage, deploy, and respond to nuclear threats, introducing a new level of strategy to international conflicts.
 DEFCON System: Track global tension levels and make decisions that impact your nation’s readiness for war (or peace).
 Environmental Policies: Implement eco-friendly projects, manage pollution, and tackle global climate challenges to maintain a sustainable future.

Also as part of our seasonal celebration, we have decorated the main menu accordingly. Enjoy the Holiday mood, we will be taking the cosmic Christmas tree down shortly after New Year's, as is tradition!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110866/05cc0ee8bc7a6931d12f23c33f5cb9eafc3631ea.png

And of course, we do our best to improve the technical state of the game with each update, big or small, and squash the various bugs that crawl from their hiding places when you report them!

Bug Fixes and Technical Improvements

 Enabled the window of a given project to stay open after clicking on the maintenance cost of a project from the list in the economy overview window; also enabled the block window to stay open after clicking on the maintenance cost of a block
 Improved the differentiation between single-province and all-province effects (previously these descriptions were identical and it was not clear whether they were for one or all provinces)
 Added the ability to switch single-thread/multi-thread save mode in the game options
 The game will now only display building effects categories (country perks or province perks) in the building details window when there is at least one effect from a given category (until now it displayed e.g. "Province perks:", with nothing under the header, which looked confusing)
 Modifiers with 0 value are no longer displayed (e.g. "Unrest Target +0") 
 Added a description to the training limit change effect - it now displays the value of by what amount it changes this limit
 Fixed the current Unrest Target value displayed in effect descriptions (it will no longer improperly show values in thousands of percents)
 Fixed the name of the autosave file in Iron mode
 Added technologies to the "show possible developments" tooltip (previously, only development projects were included)
 Removed empty sections in the "show possible developments" tooltip (e.g. when there are no buildings or projects for a given value)
 Removed the occasional double display of the percent sign in effect descriptions
 Attempting to load an empty save game folder will now result in displaying information about an invalid save instead of causing a freeze
 Fixed the behavior of hiding effects (until now the descriptions / effects of these hidden effects were visible to the player, although they should not have been)
 Added the option to set different types of modifiers for the province population change effect
 Fixed a bug where a naval officer would remain in battle state after a battle ended
 Improved serialization of battles
 Improved escaping from battles without reason
 Fixed spawning of buildings or trees depending on game settings
 Changed pathfinding for AI to not allow movement through territories they should not have access to
 AI army recruitment fixes & improvements
 General optimization improvements (effects, map particles, calculations)

Thank you for joining us on our Early Access journey, and helping us to improve the gameplay experience - if you encounter any issues or bugs, or just want to share your thoughts or suggestions, contact us either through the Realpolitiks HQ Discord, here on Steam or by email to contact@jujubee.pl.

If you are reporting a bug, be sure to describe the problem in detail, and include your save file and log file, which you can find here: C:\Users\%username%\AppData\LocalLow\Jujubee\RP3 
(Simply archive all the contents of the folder and upload it to gdrive, wetransfer or any other file sharing service, and send us the link).

Happy Strategizing!

 Nuclear Weapon Mechanics: Manage, deploy, and respond to nuclear threats, introducing a new level of strategy to international conflicts.

 Environmental Policies: Implement eco-friendly projects, manage pollution, and tackle global climate challenges to maintain a sustainable future.

We would also like to address one significant point many of you have raised: Realpolitiks 3 is not designed to accurately simulate existing countries or their cultures. Instead, it is focused on providing a fun gameplay experience, letting you lead a country in a modern setting and rule it however you choose. To keep each playthrough fresh, countries are partially randomized at the start of every campaign. While borders, political systems, and overall power stay the same, the starting stats and policies will be different each time, providing new challenges and opportunities. We have included this clarification at the start of the game and in its store description - it was never our intention to create any different expectations.

And now, without further ado, the full Change Log of our first Hotfix:

 Set default autosave interval to 15 min (only for new users - the update does not overwrite existing settings profiles, but you can set your autosave interval in Options => Other)
 Changed the name of "Realism" mode to "Standard" to avoid confusion
 Added the initial character creator for standard mode
 Added several new information tooltips to various windows
 Improved several tooltips in the economy manager
 Removed the ability to focus on the game, and to manually save the game during autosave, to prevent corrupt autosaves
 Added protection against loading a corrupted save

 Reduced the cost of maintaining a political bloc
 Fixed air officer being blocked in some cases after ending a war
 Fixed incorrect info on several projects in the Military Policy tree that claimed to modify "Population" instead of Unrest
